title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Worksheet Note: Amount of the Carried-In Credit
content:
**Definition.** For a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) enrollment, the carried-in credit is the credit balance of the enrolled service account less the cut-over reserve and less the uncleared-payment hold, rounded to the cent, and never less than zero.

**Quantities.**

1. *Credit balance*: the amount by which the account balance of the enrolled service account stands below zero, as the service account record shows it when the enrollment is taken. An account balance at or above zero gives a credit balance of zero.
2. *Most recent standard bill*: the latest standard bill of the enrolled service account, identified by the latest dated usage lines of that account; its *bill date* is the date of those usage lines.
3. *Reserve days*: the calendar days from the bill date of the most recent standard bill of the enrolled service account to the enrollment date.
4. *Reserve daily cost*: the total of the usage lines of the most recent standard bill of the enrolled service account divided by 30 (the standard bill length in days). This figure is not rounded on its own.
5. *Cut-over reserve*: the reserve days multiplied by the reserve daily cost, rounded to the cent. It keeps back the usage the enrolled service account used between its most recent standard bill and the enrollment.
6. *Uncleared-payment hold*: zero.
7. *Carried-in credit*: the credit balance less the cut-over reserve, less the uncleared-payment hold, rounded to the cent; a figure below zero is taken as zero.

**What stays behind.** The part of the credit kept back by the cut-over reserve and the uncleared-payment hold stays on the enrolled service account for its final standard bill.

### Worked figure (hypothetical records)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Account balance of the enrolled service account | -212.40 |
| Credit balance | 212.40 |
| Most recent standard bill dated | 3 May |
| Its usage lines total | 96.60 |
| Reserve daily cost: 96.60 divided by 30 | 3.22 |
| Enrollment date | 20 May |
| Reserve days: 3 May to 20 May | 17 |
| Cut-over reserve: 17 multiplied by 3.22 | 54.74 |
| Uncleared-payment hold | 0.00 |
| Carried-in credit: 212.40 less 54.74 less 0.00 | 157.66 |

In this figure 54.74 stays on the service account for its final standard bill.

**Edge figures (hypothetical).** With an account balance of -30.00 and the same cut-over reserve of 54.74, the difference falls below zero and the carried-in credit is 0.00. With an account balance of 15.00 owed, the credit balance is zero and so is the carried-in credit.
